Remark
[Nonuniqueness without a growth bound] ↗ thm:uniqueness-heat-cauchy-problem 1. ch2:2.3.3-rem-7\group Maximum Principles

Without a growth restriction, the zero-data Cauchy problem \[ u_t-\Delta u=0, \qquad u(x,0)=0 \] has infinitely many solutions; all nonzero examples grow rapidly as $|x|\to \infty $ \cite{John1982}.
